command: d=YAML.load_file(ARGV[0]); j=d.fetch("jobs").fetch("linux"); s=j.fetch("steps"); names=s.map { |x| x["name"] }; build=names.index("Build native tests before the application"); tests=names.index("Execute nonempty selected native suites"); app=names.index("Build native application after test verification"); abort "Invalid test order" unless build < tests && tests < app; abort "Unexpected timeout" unless j["timeout-minutes"]==180; abort "Missing test command" unless s[build]["run"].include?("./build_linux.sh -trlL -j 2"); abort "Missing app command" unless s[app]["run"].include?("./build_linux.sh -srlL -j 2"); puts JSON.pretty_generate({status: "PASS", test_build_index: build, test_execution_index: tests, application_build_index: app, timeout_minutes: j["timeout-minutes"], linux_execution: "NOT_RUN"})
